headline: Nigeria SEC Orders Freeze on Terror-Linked Assets
summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission directed all capital market regulated entities to immediately freeze funds and economic resources linked to United Nations-designated terrorist financiers, though market operators reported being unaware.
why: Compliance directives from securities regulators regarding asset freezes enforce international anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing standards.

impacts.name: Capital Markets
impacts.why: SEC directed capital market regulated entities to freeze terror-linked assets.
